heading: EXT. FROZEN RESERVOIR CURLING SHEET - DAWN

units.text: EXT. FROZEN RESERVOIR CURLING SHEET - DAWN
A pale sheet of ice scraped smooth between two snowbanks, the far house painted in washed-out reds.
Breath hangs over every mouth.
KAI TANAKA, thirties, broom raised, crouches at the hog line.
DESHAWN FOLEY, twenties, his rival, stands opposite in a borrowed jacket.
BIRGIT SOLBERG, sixties, skips for Kai's team and screams numbers like a general.
MRS. ACHTERBERG, seventies, the umpire, sits on a folding chair wrapped in a quilt.
YOUNG PETRO, ten, Mrs. Achterberg's grandson, holds the scoreboard stick.
Kai releases.
The stone glides, curls, kisses Deshawn's guard and drifts toward the button.
Birgit and Kai sweep together, frantic, shouting.
The stone stops a hair short.
No!
units.name: BIRGIT

units.text: Hair short, gentlemen!
units.name: DESHAWN

units.text: Kai and Deshawn shove each other chest to chest.
Both slip, both go down in a tangle, brooms skittering away.
Birgit hauls them apart by their collars.
Petro drops the scoreboard stick and runs.
Measure it!
units.name: MRS. ACHTERBERG

units.text: Everyone freezes.
Petro returns with the string, kneels, and stretches it from the button to the stone.
The ice creaks like a held breath.
It's a tie.
units.name: PETRO

units.text: The group scatters in four directions, laughing, swearing, slapping each other on the back.
